scope: 0.4.0 content primitives; web adapter implemented, native adapters planned

shared.content: Authored slot content; no generated business data
shared.states: Static primitives have no synthetic disabled, loading or selected state. Authors supply meaningful content and native attributes.
shared.semantics: Element names describe platform intent; adapters preserve meaning rather than identical DOM or prop signatures.
shared.layout: Relative type sizes, logical alignment, natural wrapping and explicit semantic colors

text.accessibility: Heading level is authored with as; visual size never selects heading semantics. No truncation or automatic live region.

card.accessibility: A grouping surface, not a button. Use real child links/buttons. Authors choose article/section semantics and title heading levels.

badge.accessibility: Status meaning is explicit text. Native anchor navigation needs href and an authored name. Changing labels do not announce automatically. No clipping of long labels.

alert.accessibility: Default static note. Authors opt into role=status for polite updates or role=alert for urgent updates, with meaningful content and native child actions. No auto-dismiss.
